title: Rethinking Human Evaluation Protocol for Text-to-Video Models: Enhancing Reliability, Reproducibility, and Practicality

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation using pairwise comparisons of generated videos to assess 'Ethical Robustness.' Annotators are guided by a rubric to evaluate videos for equitable representation and treatment of characters from diverse backgrounds (race, gender, age) and to identify the perpetuation of demographic stereotypes.
